caption: The drawing depicts a man in 18th-century attire consisting of a elaborately decorated long coat and matching knee-length breeches, both primarily red with intricate floral and geometric patterns in green, yellow, and blue. The coat has wide cuffs and is adorned with detailed designs, visible button rows, and trimmed edges. He wears a white shirt with ruffled cuffs and lace at the neck, and dark shoes with buckles. The man holds a black tricorn hat with white trim in his left hand and a walking cane in his right hand. His hair is white and styled in curls, tied at the back with a small black ribbon. In the upper left corner, there is a fabric swatch with the same multicolored ornate pattern as the suit, and in the lower right, there is a sketch of the lace cuff pattern. The background is light beige with some blue and gray shading beneath the figure, suggesting a shadow.
title: Man's Suit
